Responsible adoption

Training includes practical guidance for privacy, accuracy checks, brand voice, approvals, and when not to use AI. The goal is confidence, not reckless automation.

  • Team AI usage policy.
  • Prompt and output review rules.
  • Client data handling guidance.
  • Approval steps for public-facing work.
